definitions.short: something hollowed (as a gate), i.e. pupil of the eye
definitions.full: H892. babah [ בָּבָה ] noun feminine only עֵינוֺ בָּבַת Zech 2:12 the apple of his eye (Aramaic ; בָּבָא gate ᵑ7 Est 5:14 ; Thes below נבב to which Ges gives sense perforate , hence opening of eye ; but compare Arabic pupil of eye, perhaps = Dozy 49 babe, baby, bébé (imitating infant's prattle) i.e. child of the eye; see Hi St, Fl in ChWB i. 419 b ; compare אישׁוֺן ?).
definitions.rootNote: feminine active participle of an unused root meaning to hollow out;
